gaps_attempted.notes: Key new finding: Hielscher search results surfaced wall-plug efficiency data (80-90% from plug to liquid) not found in prior iteration. This fills the gap left by the APC International source (which gave coupling coefficient Kp ≥ 55% but no wall-plug efficiency). The UIP16000 (16 kW, 18 kHz) and UIP4000hdT (4 kW, 20 kHz) together bracket the sonofusion operating frequency range and establish the per-unit power scale for commercial industrial ultrasonic systems. Reactor-scale estimation (GW-class) remains an analogy extrapolation: e.g., a 100 MWe acoustic driver load would require ~6,250 UIP16000 units at 16 kW each, illustrating the scale challenge.
